entities.summary: Rajeev Suri is an Indian born Singaporean business executive. He has been the chairman of Digicel Group since November 2023. Prior to this, Suri was the CEO of Inmarsat from February 2021. From April 2014 to July 2020, Suri was the CEO of Nokia. Before that, he was CEO of Nokia Solutions and Networks from 2009. Suri held various positions within Nokia since 1995.
